video.title: EP 562 The BANNED ChatGPT Money Hack | AI Entrepreneur Blueprint That Crossed the Line

summary: Solo episode by Tracy of Dark Horse Entrepreneur warning AI side-hustlers about the wave of AI-enabled fraud and the enforcement crackdown in 2025-2026. He recounts malicious LLMs sold by subscription (WormGPT, FraudGPT, GhostGPT), cases such as the $25.6M Arup deepfake transfer, a $260M crypto social-engineering theft, AI-washing prosecutions, the first Take It Down Act conviction, and fraud statistics from the FBI IC3, TRM Labs and Deloitte. He then highlights anti-voice-cloning research (AntiFake, Origin Story) as a sign of an emerging market for authentication, voice protection and human-origin content certification. The takeaway is to build legitimate AI businesses and look one step downstream for the new problems AI creates.
